text_block_list.text:
Whether by the will of the gods or her
own
efforts, Матиканэфукукитару claims
victory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After witnessing her behavior before the
race,
Сайленс Судзука is worried about

Matikanefukukitaru's preoccupation with
luck.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Taking in Сайленс Судзука's concerns,

Matikanefukukitaru comes back to her
senses.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Realizing her overdependence on luck,
she
freezes up, questioning whether any
of her
victories are really her own.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
